_comment: The CPU batch is parallel across four isolated mutmut children; five ordered GPU shards run one after another, each with up to four fresh pytest workers on one leased GPU. Four GPU shards own one module each; the certification shard owns its two isolated reference/certification modules together.
All six batch module sets must be pairwise disjoint and their exact union must equal the coverage registry's thirteen reconciled modules.

batches.name: restricted_mps_cpu
batches.scope_rationale: out of default scope: the six carrier/mps mechanics modules plus the record layout are the numerical core, and their behaviour is pinned by the external Aer/YASTN/QuTiP comparison legs. This batch also already scores 0.9373 semantic, the best of the six. Run it explicitly when the carrier changes.

batches.name: restricted_mps_gpu_01_mcwf_execution
batches.scope_rationale: out of default scope: MCWF-MPS execution numerics are covered by the external comparison legs. Run explicitly when that executor changes.

batches.name: restricted_mps_gpu_02_qt_execution
batches.scope_rationale: out of default scope: QT-MPS execution numerics are covered by the external comparison legs. Run explicitly when that executor changes.

batches.name: restricted_mps_gpu_03_carrier_execution
batches.scope_rationale: out of default scope: record-construction plumbing. Its values reach the emitted record, which the comparison legs read. Run explicitly when the record layout or manifests change.

batches.name: restricted_mps_gpu_04_carrier_program
batches.scope_rationale: out of default scope: carrier program assembly. Run explicitly when the program builder changes.

batches.name: restricted_mps_gpu_05_certification
batches.scope_rationale: IN default scope: certify/ is the evaluator that judges every comparison, so no external baseline can validate it -- a broken judge reports agreement that is not there. Its fail-closed guards are also structurally invisible to green tests, since a guard that never fires looks like one that cannot fire. Mutation is the only instrument that reaches this surface.
